name: motor-vision
description: Run the backend from backend/ and the website from frontend/ (see README).

scripts.check: node --check frontend/js/recommendation-ui.js && node --check backend/services/recommendation-model.js && node --check frontend/js/about.js && node --check frontend/js/app.js && node --check frontend/js/auth-ui.js && node --check backend/server.js && node --check backend/services/auth.js && node --check backend/services/mailer.js && node --check frontend/js/risk-engine.js && node --check frontend/js/risk-data.js && node --check frontend/js/risk-ui.js && node --check backend/services/listing-import.js && node --check frontend/js/listing-link-ui.js && node --check frontend/js/valuation-ui.js && node --check frontend/js/price-engine.js
scripts.dev: echo "Open two terminals and run: npm run dev:backend  |  npm run dev:frontend" && exit 1
scripts.start: echo "Open two terminals and run: npm run start:backend  |  npm run start:frontend" && exit 1
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run check && npm --prefix frontend run check
scripts.test: node tests/frontend/smoke-test.cjs && node tests/frontend/about.test.cjs && node tests/integration/listing-import.test.cjs && node tests/integration/risk-model.test.cjs
